text: Program Description This program aims at training high-level professionals in the field of Chinese teaching and cultural exchanges of Chinese with other countries with excellent understanding and communicating abilities of Chinese language, a deep understanding of Chinese culture and Chinese national. Graduates are expected to have a good knowledge of Pedagogy and Psychology and to meet the qualifications of teaching Chinese or engaging in cultural exchanges with China. Core Courses: Advanced Chinese, Advanced Spoken Chinese Spoken, Advanced Chinese Writing Course, Chinese Newspaper Reading, Modern Chinese, Introduction to Chinese, Chinese Teaching, Pedagogy, Psychology, etc. Our school is the receiving institution of Confucius Institute Scholarship students, which can admit undergraduate students applying to study the major of Teaching Chinese to the Speakers of Other Languages with Confucius Institute Scholarship.
